```go

    "rke2-calico",
    "rke2-calico-crd",
    "rke2-canal",
    "rke2-canal-crd",
    "rke2-cilium",
    "rke2-cilium-crd",
    "rke2-coredns",
    "rke2-flannel",
    "rke2-flannel-crd",
    "rke2-ingress-nginx",
    "rke2-ingress-nginx-crd",
    "rke2-metrics-server",
    "rke2-multus",
    "rke2-snapshot-controller",
    "rke2-snapshot-controller-crd",
    "rke2-snapshot-validation-webhook",
    "rke2-traefik",
    "rke2-traefik-crd",
}
```

<a name="CNIs"></a>CNIs is the set of values rke2 v1\_35 accepts in \`cni:\`. Empty for distros that do not declare a CNI selection flag.

```go
var CNIs = []string{
    "calico",
    "canal",
    "cilium",
    "flannel",
}
```

<a name="IngressControllers"></a>IngressControllers is the set of values rke2 v1\_35 accepts in \`ingress\-controller:\`. Empty for distros that do not declare one.

```go
var IngressControllers = []string{
    "ingress-nginx",
    "traefik",
}
```
